scenario.topic: Choose a cybersecurity certification to study for together

options.name: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
options.upside: Widely recognized with comprehensive security management coverage.
options.concern: Requires significant prior experience and higher exam cost.

options.name: CompTIA Security+
options.upside: Entry-level certification with no experience required and moderate cost.
options.concern: Less depth in advanced topics compared to other certifications.

options.name: Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
options.upside: Focuses on practical hacking skills relevant to offensive security roles.
options.concern: Higher cost and requires some prior cybersecurity experience.

options.name: GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC)
options.upside: Covers technical skills with practical applications for security professionals.
options.concern: Exam cost is relatively high compared to other entry to mid-level certifications.

shared_context: Two participants want to select a cybersecurity certification to study together that balances cost, difficulty, and industry recognition. They seek certifications suitable for early to mid-career professionals aiming to enhance practical skills and job prospects.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: An early-career cybersecurity analyst focused on broad security management roles.
personas.private_goal: To gain a highly recognized certification that boosts my job prospects and covers comprehensive security topics.

A.reason_for: Highly recognized certification with broad security management focus, ideal for career growth.

B.reason_for: Affordable and no experience required, good for foundational skills.
B.reason_against: Less depth in advanced topics, which may limit long-term growth.

C.reason_for: Practical hacking skills are valuable and relevant to some security roles.
C.reason_against: Higher cost and requires some prior experience, which I currently lack.

D.reason_for: Covers technical skills with practical applications.
D.reason_against: Very high exam cost and moderate to high recognition may not justify the investment now.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: A mid-career IT professional aiming to deepen technical cybersecurity skills.
personas.private_goal: To obtain a certification that balances practical skills with strong industry recognition despite cost.

A.reason_for: High industry recognition and comprehensive coverage.
A.reason_against: Requires 5 years experience which I barely meet, and exam cost is high.

B.reason_for: Low cost and no experience required.
B.reason_against: Too basic and lacks depth for my current career level.

C.reason_for: Focus on practical offensive security skills is appealing.
C.reason_against: Cost is high and requires some experience, which is borderline for me.

D.reason_for: Strong technical focus and practical application with moderate to high recognition.
